body.p: After entry of the foregoing, claims 1-5 are pending in the application of which claim 1 is independent. No claims are amended, added or cancelled. Abstract has been amended for formality. No new matter is believed to be added herein. Entry of the amendment and reconsideration of the application are respectfully requested.

The arguments and contentions presented in the Office Action should not be construed as any acquiescence or agreement by Applicant with the stated reasoning therein regardless of whether or not the following remarks specifically address any particular argument or contention from the Office Action. Furthermore, although certain distinctions between the claims of the present application and the cited references are addressed below, these distinctions are not necessarily exhaustive.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for clarification regarding the double-patenting rejections during the telephonic interview of January 23, 2025. The Examiner confirmed that the double patenting rejection over U.S. Patent No. 7,359,782 was inadvertently and erroneously included in the Office Action, and that the claims are NOT rejected on double-patenting grounds over U.S. Patent No. 7,359,782.
The abstract of the disclosure is objected to. Abstract has been amended herein. Withdrawal of the objection is respectfully requested in view of the amendment.
Claims 1-5 are rejected on the ground of non-statutory obviousness-type double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-20 of U.S. Patent No. 11,715,072.

Without acquiescing to the propriety of the rejection, and solely in an effort to expedite prosecution, Applicant files a terminal disclaimer herewith the obviate the rejection. Withdrawal of the rejection is requested in view of the terminal disclaimer.
All claims being patentable, a notice of allowance is expeditiously solicited.

In view of the foregoing, Applicant submits that this application should be allowed and the case passed to issue. If there are any questions or issues raise by this paper or the application in general, a telephone call to the undersigned would be appreciated to expedite the prosecution of the application.

To the extent necessary, a petition for an extension of time under 37 C.F.R. § 1.136 is hereby made. Please charge any shortage in fees due in connection with the filing of this paper, including extension of time fees, to Deposit Account 50-0310 and please credit any excess fees to such deposit account.
Respectfully submitted, Dated: January 23, 2025 /Kalpesh V. Upadhye/
